component.name: WorkChat
component.summary: Team chat client for your own WorkChat server

description.p: WorkChat is a lightweight chat client for your own self-hosted WorkChat server, with direct messages, channels and message threads in one place.

ul.li: Direct messages and channels, with message threads
Voice messages and file attachments of any type
Rich-text formatting: bold, italic, strike, lists, code, quotes and links
Notifications through your own ntfy server
Works on your local network over plain http as well as over https

description.p: Channel names without the # prefix, navy rings around pictures, and slightly larger channel and bot badges.
Private message labels with filters, text weight option, emoji picker and connection dot fixes on phones.
Channel and bot badges, picture upload fixes, smoother image zoom.
Phone menu with all chat views, new icons, share to WorkChat from other Android apps, desktop fixes.
Reorganised desktop layout with global search, a Saved view and draggable panes; all channels are now private; Linux arm64 builds.
